text: Done at 2f24955. (1) The person's three answers are recorded in docs/ideas/20261120.md, section 'The HOOMD-blue agent's engine scales: three answers', with the button text as this note quotes it and what they settle (for hoomd-h2-bond only: engine_length Angstrom, engine_energy eV, engine_mass Da, each confirmed by the person) and do not settle (other bundles, engine_time, which rows take a hand-over, any crossing). (2) Da, dimension mass, is in contracts/units.json, its si_factor read from NIST's CODATA 2022 page https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?ukg and cited in its note as bohr's is; contracts/tests/test_units.py tests that Da converts to kg, not to g/mol, and that engine_mass may stand for Da and not for g/mol. The mass row the note held may now go through contracts/tools/units.py factor <unit> engine_mass --stands-for Da.
